verdict.rationale: Unstructured offers deployment in a customer's own dedicated instance or VPC with full data isolation. Its security-model docs cover private connectivity, PrivateLink and IP allowlisting for dedicated instances. A community user reports that self-hosting the official Docker image was hassle-free. However, the VPC option appears only as a pricing-page enterprise offering with tailored pricing, and fully self-hosted operation has no first-party documentation. missing for 10: first-party VPC deployment/installation guide, first-party documentation of fully self-hosted (air-gapped/Docker) operation, independent hands-on corroboration of VPC deployment.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can run the extraction stack in my own VPC or fully self-hosted when documents can't leave my infrastructure

citations.quote: Deploy Unstructured in your own dedicated instance or VPC with multi-user access, full data isolation, dedicated technical support, and pricing tailored to your needs.
Learn how Unstructured dedicated instances protect data through encryption, private connectivity, and network access controls, with and without PrivateLink.
self-hosting the official Unstructured Docker image was pretty hassle-free
